data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure step for step, in the right order (Cars tab, pick-up, optional drop-off, date picker with Done, times, Search, filters and sort), but it leaves sort order out of the parameter list and describes the filters only loosely, so an automation would have some inputs it can't fill in.
